description:
Dr. Pierre Kory speaks on Wednesday night, January 4 on the FLCCC webinar on Damar Hamlin and our "new normal".Show more *****
"You will not know the full story, or even the accurate story of what happened. If they find myocarditis, I would bet you that is censored and that will not come out. "
****
"This mass delusion that we’re all under through unrelenting propaganda and censorship. They are censoring all these things. If I have to read one more article of a young person dying where the word vaccine isn't even mentioned as a possibility...it's absolutely disgusting. And…every journalist who goes to work and writes that article and refuses to talk about what's in everyone's mind — you are complicit. You want to keep your job because you can't write the article that you know you're supposed to write and morally and ethically supposed to write which is the truth, the facts. You give all of the information that's available. You can talk about possibilities. You can write an article where it doesn't say it is the vaccine but you could, maybe, if you had ethics or morals or honesty or integrity or courage or conviction you might want to write that ...hey, maybe it's the vaccine?"
- Dr. Pierre Kory
*****
Note: This was recorded before the release on January 3rd from Damar's doctors of his substantial progress update of movement and interaction with doctors.
